# Product Enrichment Learnings

Start at `website-product-data/docs/project/learnings/README.md`, then load only the applicable repository index and detail. A learning must be evidence-backed and should state symptom, root cause, invariant, and prevention. Do not promote an unverified experiment or future proposal into a learning.
